author: reek
body: A SourceDefinition used to be a pointer: a hash, and a Perforce path where the bytes could be found. The bytes stayed in Perforce. This test writes a real chapter -- its actual text, not a description of it -- to a block device as a content-addressed, Ed25519-signed fact, boots the store back off the disk, and puts it through the same import gate the compiler's quotation gate uses. The gate must admit it, and the bytes must come back identical.

author: reek
body: The body below is deliberately hostile to the old encoding. It contains a PIPE, because a pipe is how this language writes a sum type and nearly every chapter in the tree has one; the old format was pipe-delimited and would have cut this file to pieces at its own type declaration. It contains newlines, which no single-sector fact could hold anyway -- and a fact bigger than one sector used to end the replay and take every fact behind it with it.
